E_inter pools edges of all scenes (confidence-weighted); E_intra is the mean of per-character variances over characters observed in >= 2 scenes

traits: value = clamp(ledger traits_6d + scene trait_variations deltas, -1, 1); scenes without trait_variations use character_states (legacy); a varied character without a ledger baseline is excluded (trait_ledger_missing_count)
both axes from scene_meta.nagare (event_top3/mood_top3[/logp]); stagnation thresholds are per-work and uncalibrated on real data

calibration (diagnose/3 freeze): top3 ranks weighted 0.6/0.3/0.1 (total mass 6, same as rank_weight 3+2+1), then each scene's distribution is mixed with its neighbours 0.25/0.5/0.25 (ends renormalized); scenes with *_logp keep the softmax and are only smoothed; uncalibrated on real data
annotated scenes: 7; without annotation or stale: 0; transitions are between consecutive used scenes

diagnose/3.1: spans only for scores >= 0.5 (smaller scores are count-only: *_below_span_min_count); when irony and detachment both reach it in one scene, only the rule with the larger component gap is reported (irony: |V_F - V_f|, detachment: A_F - A_f, 5-level steps; tie -> higher score; tie -> irony) and the other is counted in dedup_suppressed_count
